# Axis catalogue (generated from tools/axis_lib.py, do not edit by hand)

Name the group after the thing (`mv-<kind>-<thing>`); the axis is computed from the drawing by the rule in column 2 (`tools/axisfix.py`, automatic in build3). Column 3 = motion kinds that fit, column 4 = kinds that are reported as wrong.

| thing (name words) | axis rule | kinds that fit | kinds that do not | group holds / note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| tree, trunk, oak, pine, palm, birch, willow, sapling, bush, shrub, hedge | **base** (발(밑동)) | sway tilt core-sway topple | spin wobble roll orbit tremble | trunk + crown only; no ground, shadow, water or other trees (one group per tree) |
| grass, reed, cattail, stalk, stem, wheat, rice, bamboo, fern, weed, kelp, seaweed … | **base** (발(밑동)) | sway tilt core-sway grow | spin wobble roll orbit | one clump per group (splitclumps.py); no pond / soil / shadow inside |
| sign, signpost, post, pole, mast, flagpole, lamppost, streetlight, lamp-post, tower, lighthouse, chimney … | **base** (발(밑동)) | sway tilt topple core-sway shake | spin wobble roll orbit | the whole upright thing (a sign = post + every board); it stands ON the ground, the ground stays outside |
| candle, torch, bottle, vase, jar, bowl, glass, cup, mug, flask, beaker, test-tube … | **base** (발(밑동)) | sway tilt topple core-sway shake wobble core-wobble | spin orbit | a standing container tips from its foot (wobble is fine: a jar rocking) |
| person, people, man, woman, kid, child, boy, girl, figure, scientist, researcher, farmer … | **base** (발(밑동)) | sway nod breathe hop creep path swim float bob tilt | spin roll flip orbit rotor | a creature sways from its FEET; its tail / legs / neck / wings are their own joint or chain groups INSIDE this one |
| lantern, puppet, marionette, hanging-lamp, chandelier, bell, pendulum, bob, plumb, rope, cord, string … | **top** (매단 점) | swing pendulum sway | spin roll topple | the hanging thing + its cord; the pivot is where the cord meets the ceiling / branch / hand / pole |
| spider, bat | **top** (매단 점) | swing pendulum float | spin roll | hangs from its thread / the ceiling |
| wheel, gear, cog, sprocket, fan, propeller, prop, rotor, turbine, blades, windmill-blades, pinwheel … | **round** (둥근 면 중심) | rotor spin core-spin turn | sway topple wobble | the round part only (a windmill: blades = rotor, tower = a separate standing group); gears mesh (gearmesh.py) |
| hand, needle, pointer, arrow-hand, minute, hour, second, compass-needle, indicator, gauge-needle | **round** (둥근 면 중심) | rotor joint | sway spin | a clock / gauge hand turns about the CENTRE of its dial, not about its own middle |
| tail, tailfin, fin, flipper, fluke, tentacle, arm, forearm, leg, foreleg, hindleg, thigh … | **contact** (몸에 닿는 점) | joint chain flap wiggle | sway spin rotor topple | the part only, drawn so it OVERLAPS the body by a few px; chains nest (-1 holds -2); the whole creature's travel group holds the parts |
| door, lid, hatch, gate, drawbridge, visor, cover, book-cover, page, shutter, window, trapdoor … | **contact** (몸에 닿는 점) | joint swing | spin rotor sway | hinged along the edge that touches the frame / body: draw the hinge side overlapping the frame |
| hammer, axe, pickaxe, sword, dagger, knife, bat, club, racket, wand, baton, cane … | **contact** (몸에 닿는 점) | joint swing | spin rotor sway | a hand-held tool pivots where the HAND holds it (net: pole end + bag in one group, or the bag swings from the rim) |
| flag, pennant, windsock, sail, streamer, bunting | **edge** (깃대 쪽 가장자리) | flagwave swing sway | spin rotor topple | the cloth only; the pole is a standing group of its own (or inside, in which case the pivot is the pole foot) |
| seesaw, see-saw, teeter, lever, balance, scale, scales, beam, plank, raft-balance | **center** (중심) | tilt swing pendulum | spin roll topple | the beam pivots on its fulcrum (its centre, or data-pivot on the pin if drawn off-centre) |
| boat, ship, raft, canoe, kayak, ferry, yacht, submarine, sub, barge, buoy, lifeboat … | **center** (중심) | bob tilt path glide float | spin roll rotor sway | the hull + everything on it bobs together (sails may be their own flag groups) |
| balloon, airship, blimp, zeppelin, kite, parachute, cloud-ride, ufo, saucer, drone, helicopter, plane … | **center** (중심) | float hover path glide ascend sink bob tilt | sway topple rotor | moves as one piece; propellers / rotors are separate round groups inside |
| planet, moon, sun, earth, mars, jupiter, saturn, venus, mercury, world, globe, asteroid … | **center** (중심) | spin wobble breathe swell heartbeat float orbit core-spin core-wobble | sway topple | round thing: turns / breathes about its own centre; the hands of a clock are separate round groups |
| box, crate, chest, barrel, drum, can, bucket, basket, cart, wagon, barrow, sled … | **center** (중심) | drop bouncing rollby slide skid toss magnet shake squash popin rise topple | rotor pendulum | a solid object; topple / tilt pivot at the bottom corner is set by the build |
| swarm, flock, school, shoal, herd, cloud-of, cluster, colony, tadpole, larva, larvae, cercaria … | **center** (중심) | wiggle swim float path drift orbit breathe heartbeat swell spin rotor turn | sway topple joint | a free swimmer / a crowd of small things moves as one about its own centre; no axis to attach |
| tile, card, panel, plate, slab, domino, brick-tile, block-tile, sheet, poster, photo, picture … | **center** (중심) | topple drop bouncing slide skid toss popin rise fade flip shake | rotor pendulum | a flat tile / card: topples from its bottom corner (set by the build), otherwise moves as one piece |
| water, sea, ocean, lake, pond, river, stream, waves, surf, puddle, rain, snow … | **none** (축 없음(회전 금지)) | ripple flicker drift fade breathe swell glint dash scroll liquid fill bubble | joint rotor sway swing pendulum spin topple tilt wobble | liquids, gases, light and ground have no axis: use ripple / flicker / drift / fade, never a rotation |

Rules: base = foot (x-centre of the narrow shapes touching the bottom, y = bottom) · top = hanging point (same at the top) · contact = centroid of the part outline points that lie on the body / parent link (a hinge-pin circle inside the group wins) · round = centre of the biggest circle/ellipse in the group, else of the smallest round body shape under the part · edge = midpoint of the side that touches a pole · center = box centre · none = must not rotate.

Tolerance: a written `data-pivot` farther than 12 px from the catalogue point is reported by attachcheck.py (`axisfix.py --force` rewrites it).
